guides.titleZh: 全生態區域拓荒與土木工程詳盡攻略
guides.subtitleEn: From the Withered Wasteland to the heights of the Sparkling Skylands, every region in Pokopia presents unique environmental hazards and requires specific engineering tasks to restore.
guides.subtitleZh: 從面臨極端乾旱的枯萎荒野，到由漂浮垃圾組成的閃耀空島，Pokopia 的每個區域都充滿官方設定的環境危機與重建任務。以下為各區域拓荒的完整解析與節點引導。

sections.contentEn: The starting region is plagued by extreme drought and zero vegetation. You must learn core water-shaping skills and initiate the very first computer repair.
sections.contentZh: 本作的教學與起始區域，面臨著極端的乾旱危機。百變怪玩家在此必須學習水系技能，拯救枯竭生命並啟動首座寶可夢中心。

image.captionEn: Squirtle's early water dousing is necessary to wake Onix.
image.captionZh: 傑尼龜的水槍技能是起死回生、重啟荒野的唯一捷徑。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 尋找並救援傑尼龜
steps.descEn: Find the dehydrated Squirtle. Guide it to hydration to copy its 'Water Gun' skill.
steps.descZh: 在乾涸的沙漠中找到脫水、奄奄一息的傑尼龜，給予水分救援後，百變怪即可學會並運用「水槍」複製专長。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 呼風喚雨拯救大岩蛇
steps.descEn: Use Water Gun to gradually hydrate the parched land, satisfying Onix and triggering regional rain.
steps.descZh: 在沙漠中不斷使用水槍滋潤枯竭乾裂的土地，引發暴風雨和降雨，成功拯救被困的大岩蛇。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 重建荒地寶可夢中心
steps.descEn: Construct the initial infrastructure to establish a stable local headquarters and access basic workbenches.
steps.descZh: 搜集基礎木塊與碎石，修復荒原寶可夢中心與大門，這將開啟你在 Pokopia 的正式基地與初期家具合成站。

sections.contentEn: A flooded coastal region thick with washed-up trash and waterlogged communication terminals.
sections.contentZh: 充滿嚴重水患、陰暗霧霾且滿佈不可燃垃圾的廢棄海灘，也是玩家接觸回收與發電工業的起點。

image.captionEn: Trubbish & Garbodor process beach debris to generate early Iron Ore.
image.captionZh: 破破袋與灰塵山能將海灘鋪天蓋地的垃圾轉化為極度缺乏的鐵礦砂。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 以方塊阻斷溢流水患
steps.descEn: Use dirt or stone block flooring to manually seal the broken fountains leaking into the computer system grid.
steps.descZh: 海灘中央的溢流噴泉正淹沒網路終端。玩家需要手動放置泥土或石地板方塊修補破損噴泉，阻斷溢流水源。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 喵喵避難所與波加曼除泥
steps.descEn: Build a shelter with a 'Mushroom Lamp' for Meowth to lure Piplup to wash away heavy mud banks.
steps.descZh: 為喵喵建造包含「蘑菇燈」的專屬避難所，這能吸引波加曼使用水流清洗沉重的泥堆，隨後建立垃圾收集站吸引破破袋。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 「Brighten things up!」大型發電工程
steps.descEn: Wake Mosslax. Locate and repair the coastal water wheel, windmill, and local charging station. Pave Power Poles to complete the network.
steps.descZh: 喚醒發電巨樹（Mosslax），修復海灘風力發電機、燈塔水車與底座充電站，製作架設「電線桿」將導線引入城鎮，讓火系夥伴維持最大發電點亮城鎮。

sections.contentEn: Buried beneath layers of dense volcanic ash, this region hides lost temples, culinary masters, and deep metallurgical ores.
sections.contentZh: 被厚重火山灰完全掩埋的巨型遺跡與紅色岩壁地盆，這裡是玩家冶煉銅鐵錠與碎裂堅硬金屬塊的修煉場。

image.captionEn: Magmar powers up furnaces inside the furnace chamber.
image.captionZh: 鴨嘴火獸能提供超高窯烤燃燒專長，幫助熔煉與鍛造高強度金屬。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 烤製麵包解救主廚 Dente
steps.descEn: Locate trapped Dente. Build a 'Bread Oven' to bake wheat bread, eat it to gain strength, and hack his chain bonds.
steps.descZh: 在岩壁深處的土屑平房內尋獲受困的廚師「Dente」。玩家需就地搭建「麵包爐」，烤製小麥麵包並一口吃下，獲得怪力擊碎鐵鍊救出主廚。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 漢堡排廚藝與強化碎岩術
steps.descEn: Bring Magmar to furnace, smelt copper to forge a Frying Pan. Cook and eat a Burger Patty to upgrade Ditto's Rock Smash.
steps.descZh: 吸引鴨嘴火獸（Magmar），運用其熔爐燃燒天賦將銅礦石冶製成銅錠，打造「平底鍋」。烹煮並享用多汁的「漢堡排」以永久強化百變怪的「碎岩」專長，足以擊碎黑色巨型金屬塊！

sections.contentEn: Floating trash islands and massive unfinished skyscrapers. Requires advanced aerial traversal and skyscraper architectural blueprints.
sections.contentZh: 由漫天漂浮的科技廢棄垃圾島嶼、巨鋼鷹架與未完工摩天大樓組成的超高海拔區域，土木工程消耗最巨。

image.captionEn: Establish Waterside Boat to copy Dragonite's Glide skill.
image.captionZh: 快龍的加入能使玩家傲視群雄，滑翔穿梭於相隔甚遠的雲霧空島。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 水邊小艇與快龍滑翔天空
steps.descEn: Build a Waterside Boat habitat to summon Dragonite and copy its Glide ability, opening flight pathways.
steps.descZh: 在浮岛邊緣設立優雅的「水邊小艇」棲息地以吸引高傲的快龍（Dragonite），向其模仿「滑翔」實用天賦，方能平穩橫渡致命高空裂隙。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 巨鍛匠與齒輪升降梯
steps.descEn: Meet Tinkmaster. Trade Concrete and Iron Ingots to acquire Special Gears to assembly the elevator platform.
steps.descZh: 找到空島頂端的主匠巨鍛匠（Tinkmaster），繳交重型混凝土與鐵錠，訂製關鍵的「特殊齒輪」，並藉此修復跨區域的重力升降平台。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 摩天大樓重建（2F → 4F 全樓層）
steps.descEn:
Reconstruct the skyscraper floor by floor — each floor takes a full hour of real time to cure before the next can begin.
• 2F: 25 Concrete · 10 Glass · 5 Pokémetal · 10 Iron Ingots.
• 3F: 25 Concrete · 10 Glass · 10 Glow Stones · 15 Copper Ingots. Return to Rocky Ridges to shove a Strength block and mine the Glow Stones, then escort Chef Dente up to assist.
• 4F: 40 Concrete · 15 Glass · 10 Paper · 10 Bricks · 20 Lumber. Escort Peakychu from Bleak Beach to round out the construction team. Stepping onto the rooftop after 4F triggers the Mewtwo encounter.
steps.descZh:
逐層重建這座終極摩天大樓，每一層皆需現實時間整整 1 小時凝固成形，才能接續下一層。
• 2F：25 混凝土 · 10 玻璃 · 5 寶可金屬 · 10 鐵錠。
• 3F：25 混凝土 · 10 玻璃 · 10 發光石 · 15 銅錠。需回到岩石山脊推開力量方塊開採發光石，並護送主廚 Dente 前來協助。
• 4F：40 混凝土 · 15 玻璃 · 10 紙張 · 10 磚塊 · 20 木材。須從荒涼海灘護送 Peakychu 加入施工團隊。完成 4F 步上屋頂，即可觸發與超夢（Mewtwo）的相遇。

guides.titleZh: 新手必讀：實用 QoL 密技與隱藏自動化機制
guides.subtitleEn: From linking your storage boxes to forming the ultimate automated production trio, these are the early-game secrets and mechanics the game doesn't explicitly tell you.
guides.subtitleZh: 從收納箱與工作台的連動，到如何湊齊後期最強的自動化生產三人組，這裡整理了遊戲初期必須了解的隱藏機制與小細節。

sections.titleZh: 新手首選推薦：妙蛙種子
sections.contentEn: When choosing your first partner, Bulbasaur is highly recommended. Not only does it have the 'Farming' specialty that significantly accelerates early crop yields, but placing tall-grass habitats early on quickly levels up your Environment Level, unlocking crucial workbench upgrades.
sections.contentZh: 在選擇初始夥伴時，極度推薦擁有「栽種」專長的妙蛙種子。牠不僅能大幅加速初期的農場收成，配合盡早佈置長草棲息地，能讓你快速提升「環境等級」，提前解鎖關鍵的工作台升級圖紙。

image.captionEn: Bulbasaur is highly recommended for starting farmers due to its Leafage skill.
image.captionZh: 妙蛙種子因具備「栽種」與「樹葉」專長，也是新手農夫非常推薦的開局選擇。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 開局招募妙蛙種子
steps.descEn: Utilize Leafage and Farming talents of Bulbasaur to secure early wheat and tomato output.
steps.descZh: 利用妙蛙種子的「栽種」與「樹葉」專長，在初創農田瞬間加速各類穀物收割，不需浪費手動體力。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 大批鋪設高草叢與樹木
steps.descEn: Bulbasaur and bird variants love greenery. Paving hedges expands town score quickly in the first 24 hours.
steps.descZh: 在基地周遭緊湊地鋪設 10-15 格高草與樹籬，能在第一天就取得充沛的城鎮綠意加成，極限拉高環境評分。

sections.titleZh: 超級自動化生產三人組
sections.contentEn: Once you hit the mid-game, manual material gathering becomes a chore. To fully automate, recruit Garbodor (Recycle), Aipom (Gather), and Pikachu (Generate). Aipom collects scattered raw materials, Garbodor converts trash into usable ores, and Pikachu powers the processing machinery. Placing their habitats tightly around a central refinement block yields a self-sustaining loop.
sections.contentZh: 當你開始面臨資源短缺時，務必設法湊齊「灰塵山＋長尾怪手＋皮卡丘」的超級自動化生產三人組。長尾怪手負責搬運，皮卡丘負責發電照明，而灰塵山與破破袋能將垃圾不斷轉化為鐵礦，解決中期鐵錠短缺的大麻煩。

image.captionEn: Trubbish & Garbodor form the backbone of your automated trash-to-iron factory line.
image.captionZh: 灰塵山、長尾怪手與皮卡丘是前中期的自動化鐵礦生產三人組，能大幅提升生產效率。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 長尾怪手（Aipom）高速搬運
steps.descEn: Aipom serves as the logistical spine, sweeping raw materials from gathering nodes to storages automatically.
steps.descZh: 指派長尾怪手負責所有資源堆的就近搬運與庫存歸檔，完全消滅玩家每次跑來跑去搬原木的體力垃圾時間。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 灰塵山（Garbodor）垃圾淘鐵
steps.descEn: Place Recycle specialty near coastal scrap yards to convert unburnable rubbish into highly-coveted raw iron ore.
steps.descZh: 將灰塵山與破破袋緊密配置在回收大氣泡周圍，源源不絕將不可燃的海灘廢品過濾提煉為純淨鐵砂。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 皮卡丘（Pikachu）電能運轉
steps.descEn: Pikachu provides electricity to accelerate furnace blowers and workspace comfort light.
steps.descZh: 電氣屬性皮卡丘負責為所有的研磨器、大熔煉鼓風爐及自動包裝設備高頻發電，使整條產線滿載運算。

sections.titleZh: 工作台連動與鋪路快捷鍵
sections.contentEn: These hidden QoL mechanics—widely shared on community boards like Bahamut—save enormous amounts of manual effort once your town starts to scale up.
sections.contentZh: 以下是巴哈姆特等社群廣為流傳的隱藏 QoL 機制。當你的城鎮開始巨型化時，善用它們能省下大量手動操作的時間。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 收納箱與工作台自動連動
steps.descEn: Place a Storage Box within 2 blocks of any Workbench and the bench will pull materials straight from the box during crafting — no need to shuffle items into your pockets first.
steps.descZh: 只要將「收納箱」放置在距離「工作台」2 格的範圍以內，工作台合成時就會自動讀取箱內物資，完全不需先手動把材料挪進背包。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 按住 ZR 連續鋪設方塊
steps.descEn: For large landscaping jobs—such as Umbreon's 300 road blocks or Jolteon's 100 electrical blocks—hold the 'ZR' trigger while walking to auto-lay flooring continuously in a straight line.
steps.descZh: 面對大型整地工程（例如月亮伊布的 300 塊道路或雷伊布的 100 塊電力方塊），只要按住「ZR」鍵邊走，就能沿路線自動連續鋪設方塊。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 十字鍵快速切換專長
steps.descEn: Scroll the D-pad to instantly switch between copied abilities, and quickly assign a specific Pokémon to a task—such as commissioning a Fire-type to keep an ore furnace burning.
steps.descZh: 利用十字鍵快速捲動切換已複製的能力，並迅速指派特定寶可夢執行工作，例如委託火系夥伴持續顧著熔礦爐燒礦。

sections.titleZh: 營運優化：監視器與電磁飄浮
sections.contentEn: As your town grows huge, two endgame tools eliminate the most tedious chores: remote monitoring and telekinetic terraforming.
sections.contentZh: 隨著城鎮巨型化，兩項後期工具能徹底消除最繁瑣的雜事：遠端監控與隔空整地。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 監視器 (Security Cameras)
steps.descEn: Install cameras to monitor habitats remotely and receive a notification the moment a target Pokémon spawns—removing the need to patrol back and forth across regions.
steps.descZh: 架設監視器即可遠端監控各棲息地，當目標寶可夢生成時立即收到通知，徹底解決反覆跨區巡邏的困擾。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 電磁飄浮 (Magnet Rise)
steps.descEn: Post-game, find Magnemite in the spaceship crater and build a 'Factory Warehouse' habitat (Metal Drum, Messy Cables, Control Unit, Street Lamp) to learn it. Press Y to instantly recycle blocks; hold Y to telekinetically grab and relocate entire trees or boulders—completely revolutionizing large-scale terraforming.
steps.descZh: 通關後在太空船坑洞中發現小磁怪，建立「工廠倉庫」棲息地（需金屬桶、凌亂電線、控制單元與路燈）後即可習得。按 Y 鍵可瞬間破壞回收方塊；長按 Y 鍵則能隔空抓取並移動整棵樹木或巨石，徹底顛覆大規模地形改造的體驗。

guides.titleEn: All Legendary Encounters: Beasts, Birds, Mewtwo & Mew
guides.titleZh: 全傳說寶可夢遭遇攻略：聖獸、神鳥、超夢與夢幻
guides.subtitleEn: From the first clifftop sighting of Raikou to the 27-slate Mew puzzle, Pokopia hides its legendaries behind major engineering projects and world-spanning scavenger hunts. Here is every encounter, in the order you can reasonably reach them.
guides.subtitleZh: 從懸崖頂端初見雷公，到 27 塊石板的夢幻解謎，Pokopia 將傳說寶可夢深埋在宏大工藝與地道探索後。本篇為您排除所有幻覺，匯集各大前線最精確的召喚指南。

stats.optimalTimeZh: 通關後最頂級戰術挑戰

sections.titleZh: 雷公 ── 雷鳴夢境群島
sections.contentEn: Raikou is the first legendary you can reach. The first sighting is free, but full recruitment routes through the randomly generated Dream Islands.
sections.contentZh: 雷公是你能接觸到的第一隻傳說寶可夢。初次目睹是免費的，但要真正收歸麾下，必須經由隨機生成的夢境群島才能達成。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 懸崖頂端初次目擊
steps.descEn: After lighting up Bleak Beach by connecting every renewable power source, climb to the clifftop to meet Raikou for the very first time.
steps.descZh: 在荒涼海灘完成所有再生能源串聯、點亮城鎮後，攀上懸崖頂端，即可與雷公初次碰面。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 飄飄球與夢境群島入口
steps.descEn: Hand a Pikachu Doll to Drifloon to be carried to the 'Pikachu Doll Dream Island (Oceanic)'. The doll type determines the island biome.
steps.descZh: 將「皮卡丘娃娃」交予飄飄球（Drifloon），由牠帶你飛抵「皮卡丘娃娃夢境島（海洋型）」。娃娃的種類會決定島嶼的生物群系。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 深洞擊礦圓滿招募
steps.descEn: Venture into the cave's deepest chamber, eat a Burger Patty to power up Rock Smash, and shatter the heavy metal blocks sealing the core. Recruiting Raikou dramatically boosts the region's environment level.
steps.descZh: 深入洞穴最底層，食用「漢堡排」強化怪力碎岩，擊破封鎖核心通道的沉重金屬方塊。成功招募雷公後，可大幅提升該區域的環境等級。

sections.titleZh: 夢幻 ── 27 塊阿爾法未知石板壁畫
sections.contentEn: Mew is locked behind a major geographical exploration puzzle. There are precisely 27 alphabetical slot gaps on Withered Wasteland mural. No shortcuts exist — bring a Search specialty teammate or a Dowsing Machine to spot glowing golden sites.
sections.contentZh: 在無垠的枯萎荒野（Withered Wasteland），隱藏著一幅雕刻著 27 個未知圖騰 (Unown) 英文字母插槽的古老地底壁畫。要與夢幻做夥伴，你必須解開這個龐大的石板解謎工程。

image.captionEn: Mew unlocks only after inserting all 27 distinct mysterious slates in Withered Wasteland.
image.captionZh: 夢幻在壁畫石板槽完美填入 27 枚不同字母塊後便會祥和而降。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 尋墓：破壁進入地下暗道
steps.descEn: Navigate to the Withered Wasteland Pokemon Center right side, shatter the brickwork to the north, cut metal fencing with upgraded slash to descend.
steps.descZh: 從枯萎荒野寶可夢中心右方的碎路向北尋進，使用「碎岩」擊碎崩裂的岩壁後向左切入，施展強化居合斬技能切斷老舊金屬絲防護網，順著樓梯進入地底通道最底部。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 挖掘：搜集 27 顆神聖石板
steps.descEn: Raid random golden shiny dig points globally. Bring partners with 'Search' talent or craft a Dowsing Machine to map buried slates directional vectors.
steps.descZh: 在全地圖荒野隨機生成的「發光黃金挖掘點」進行開採。強烈建議攜帶「搜尋 (Search)」天賦的隊友，或在腰包裝備「尋寶機器（Dowsing Machine）」，它將精準發出震盪定位音，助你集滿 27 枚互不重複的神秘文字石板。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 填槽：組裝壁面引導夢幻
steps.descEn: Slide all 27 alphabetical slates correctly into the ancient mural slots to summon the playful phantom.
steps.descZh: 走回地下暗道，將收集的 27 個圖騰石板一一滑入古老遺跡壁凹槽內。拼圖完成瞬間，夢幻將在神聖光暈中出現，高興地與玩家碰拳同行！

sections.titleZh: 解鎖召喚傳奇：鳳王與洛奇亞神之鈴鐺
sections.contentEn: Exclusive summoning bells require cross-referenced milestones to trigger. Complete the requirements from community databases.
sections.contentZh: 這兩位神話守護者從不隨意降風。要解鎖引導道具「透明鈴鐺」與「海神鈴鐺」配方，你需要滿足極為宏大的城都與關都探索成就。

image.captionEn: Lugia listens to the coastal bell toll.
image.captionZh: 海神洛奇亞會在地底海角或發電廠港灣傾聽「海神鈴鐺」的深海鳴響。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 招滿三聖獸，解鎖「透明鈴鐺」
steps.descEn: Complete Johto legendary recruitment cycle on Dream Island first. Unlocks the 'Clear Bell' blueprint to summon Ho-Oh from Palette high peaks.
steps.descZh: 在多個浮動的夢境群島中，成功招募到雷公等全部三隻城都地區聖獸，這會使巨蔓藤博士恍然大悟，向你交付「透明鈴鐺」的手工配方，專為呼喚鳳王降臨而設。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 降服閃電鳥，解鎖「海神鈴鐺」
steps.descEn: Meet and resolve Zapdos inside Abandoned Power Plant. Tidal Bell blueprint unlocks to command Lugia from seaside cliffs.
steps.descZh: 解鎖最高點發電廠並降服閃電鳥（若牠是你最後一隻遇見的關都神鳥），將自動在你的製作面板釋放極其古老的「海神鈴鐺」藍圖，能在海神海灣深底牽扯下喚出海之霸主 ── 洛奇亞。

sections.titleZh: 終局三神鳥祭壇：極限材料與勞力需求
sections.contentEn: Constructing the sacred elements of Kanto birds is highly demanding on materials and specified labor fields.
sections.contentZh: 在真新鎮的三個島嶼頂點，靜躺著三個巨大金色精靈球，裡面裝載著三神鳥祭壇的終極大型土木工程圖紙。這些工程耗資之恐怖，位列全作之首：

steps.nodeTitleZh: 火焰鳥的烈焰祭壇 (Altar of Flame)
steps.descEn: Requires 50 Copper Ingots, 50 Gold Ingots, 50 Lava Rocks, and 10 Pokémetals. Extremely massive grid footprint (~33×35). Pave carefully over the volcanic caldera.
steps.descZh:
建材配方：50 個銅錠、50 個金錠、50 個熔岩岩石、10 個高級寶可金屬。
注意事項：此項目在 Reddit 社群被公認佔地極廣（約 33×35 格），極易卡死，需要先在火山核心地段開鑿深溝、疏導岩漿溢流後，才可著手鋪設底座。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 閃電鳥的廢棄發電廠 (Abandoned Power Plant)
steps.descEn: Requires 50 Copper Ingots, 50 Iron Ingots, 50 Sea Glass Shards, 50 Bricks, 10 Pokemetals. Mandates exactly 15 active worker mons involving Build, Generate, Crush, and Flying abilities.
steps.descZh:
建材配方：50 銅錠、50 鐵錠、50 海玻璃碎片、50 磚塊、10 寶可金屬。
施工天賦限制：極其恐怖的施工難關，必須同時指派高達 15 隻寶可夢動工！且施工名單中必須嚴格包含擁有「建造」、「發電」、「粉碎」及「飛行」四項特定技能的夥伴。如果你在該區域湊不齊這些專長夥計，必須利用區域傳送門把牠們從天空群島或海灘調遣過來！

steps.nodeTitleZh: 急凍鳥的冰結之室 (Freezing Chambers)
steps.descEn: Requires 50 Stone, 50 Ice Blocks, 10 Crystal Shards, and 10 Pokemetals. Construct on highest cold peaks.
steps.descZh:
建材配方：50 石體塊、50 凜冬冰塊、10 深邃水晶碎片、10 高級寶可金屬。
建造細節：建在北邊孤崖頂點。冰塊需使用冰系寶可夢在淡水盆批量吐息凝結產出。

guides.titleEn: Team Initiation Challenge: Complete 8 Badges Pathway
guides.titleZh: 團隊入會挑戰：全 8 枚徽章物資需求與通關路徑
guides.subtitleEn: To trigger the final credits and complete your restoration journey, you must submit specific materials at the mysterious tower on Bleak Beach to acquire all 8 badges.
guides.subtitleZh: 為了解鎖終局製作人員名單、完成世界復育之旅，玩家必須在荒涼海灘的神秘高塔中，依序交納對應的重工業精煉物資，取得象徵榮耀的 8 枚徽章。以下為各階段的詳盡需求與拓荒指引。

sections.titleZh: 第 1 至 4 階段：基建與精煉物資考驗
sections.contentEn: These early badges test basic farming and metallurgy refinement skills.
sections.contentZh: 前四枚徽章著重於檢驗玩家在基本農業、簡易加工與初期重金屬冶煉方面的自動化搭建水平。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 1. 岩石徽章
steps.descEn:
Requires 5 Nanab Berries (蘋野果).
Strategy: Simply perform a Headbutt (頭錘) action on any Nanab Berry tree in Withered Wasteland.
steps.descZh:
物資需求：5 顆蘋野果 (Nanab Berries)。
獲取策略：對著枯萎荒野中的蘋野果樹施展「頭錘」衝撞即可輕鬆震落，是毫無壓力的第一關卡。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 2. 瀑布徽章
steps.descEn:
Requires 10 Beans, 10 Tomatoes, 10 Wheat.
Strategy: Beans and Tomatoes are mined/foraged on Bleak Beach. Wheat crops must be unlocked in Rocky Ridges first.
steps.descZh:
物資需求：10 顆豆子、10 顆番茄、10 綑小麥。
獲取策略：豆子與番茄可直接在荒涼海灘採集取得；小麥則需要先推進主線至岩石山脊，獲得種子後回基地栽種收割。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 3. 雷電徽章
steps.descEn:
Requires 20 Lumber, 5 Wool, 10 Paper.
Strategy: Extract Lumber via Scyther (Cut), periodic fleece from Mareep for Wool, and refine waste paper in Sparking Skylands via Recycle specialty (Trubbish) to yield Paper.
steps.descZh:
物資需求：20 塊木材、5 捲絨毛、10 張紙張。
獲取策略：圓木需委託飛天螳螂以「居合斬」加工成木材；絨毛需建造咩利羊棲息地定期收割；紙張則在空島收集廢紙後交由破破袋提煉。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 4. 彩虹徽章
steps.descEn:
Requires 40 Bricks, 20 Gold Ingots, 50 Concrete.
Strategy: Bake Soft Clay (triggered by rain) via Torchic to get Bricks. Melt Gold ore in Rocky Ridges. Process Limestone via Golem and Conkeldurr in the Concrete Mixer.
steps.descZh:
物資需求：40 塊磚塊、20 塊金錠、50 塊混凝土。
獲取策略：軟泥（下雨天於荒原取得）委託火稚雞或小火龍窯烤成紅磚；金錠於岩石山脊開採熔煉；混凝土則需在空島利用隆隆岩和修建老匠在攪拌機中加工。

sections.titleZh: 第 5 至 8 階段：高階電網、家具裝潢與終局通關
sections.contentEn: The final stretch tests large-scale energy piping, advanced furniture manufacturing, and ultimate game completion.
sections.contentZh: 最後四枚徽章對玩家的跨區域調電能力、高級生活家具圖紙收集度，以及大後期成就提出了全方位檢配要求。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 5. 靈魂徽章
steps.descEn:
Requires 50 Electricity, 10 Crystal Shards, 5 Special Gears.
Strategy: Wire coastal wind/water electric hubs to the tower using Power Poles. Dig Crystal Shards in Rocky Ridges. Commission Tinkmaster (Tinkaton) in Skylands for Special Gears.
steps.descZh:
物資需求：50 點電力、10 個水晶碎片、5 個特殊齒輪。
獲取策略：玩家需架設大量電線桿，將海灘的風力與水輪發電機電網拉至高塔；水晶碎片在遺跡開採取得；齒輪則需帶混凝土和鐵錠向空島的巨鍛匠訂製。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 6. 沼澤徽章
steps.descEn:
Requires 4 Industrial Beds, 4 Resort Lamps, 4 Office Desks.
Strategy: Find furniture blueprints inside Poké Balls hidden across various biomes, craft them on the advanced workbench.
steps.descZh:
物資需求：4 張工業床、4 盞度假村燈、4 張辦公桌。
獲取策略：考驗家具合成能力。此階段所需的進階家具藍圖全數散落於世界遍地的隱秘精靈球中，收集齊全後在工作台消耗金屬與布料進行裝潢合成實物。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 7. 火山徽章
steps.descEn:
Requires 1 Washing Machine, 1 Refrigerator, 1 Game Boy.
Strategy: Reach Level 5 Environment Level in the three starting areas to unlock appliances. The rare Game Boy component is gifted upon maxing out Sparkling Skylands.
steps.descZh:
物資需求：1 台洗衣機、1 台冰箱、1 台 Game Boy。
獲取策略：家電大廠解鎖！洗衣機與冰箱的設計圖需要玩家將前三個生態區的環境評分提升至滿級 5 級方能解鎖；最為稀有且昂貴的 Game Boy 則是空島滿級時的專屬餽贈圖紙。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 8. 最終通關挑戰
steps.descEn:
Requires 1 Precious Photo, 2 Party Poppers.
Strategy: Earn Party Poppers in initial level-maxing. Submit the Precious Photo to initiate the beautiful final credits animation where Professor Tangrowth and Ditto wave goodbye.
steps.descZh:
物資需求：1 張珍愛照片、2 個派對拉炮。
獲取策略：派對拉炮能在荒原滿級任務中免費贈予；交回照片後，高塔將正式完成修復。你將迎來溫暖感人的結尾，巨蔓藤博士與百變怪燃放拉炮，並將照片送入深空，暗示人類探索太空船終尋得地球萌芽。

guides.titleZh: 專業圖鑑工具：網路五大權威資料庫與機制數據深度應用
guides.subtitleEn: Unlock hidden formulas, precise grid layouts, and milestone bonuses by utilizing the top databases tracked by the active community.
guides.subtitleZh: 為了解鎖隱藏神裝食譜、精確的網格佈建與圖鑑里程碑獎勵，本篇整合了網路上最熱門的《寶可夢 Pokopia》專業站點，並剖析各大工具的引路強項。

sections.titleZh: 各大站點實行指標與核心價值剖析
sections.contentEn: These five professional wikis handle specific sub-mechanics from precise decorations to statistical charts.
sections.contentZh: 這五個權威社群站點提供了不同維度的攻略，幫助你克服資訊不對稱，極速達成 300 隻全圖鑑收集與工業鏈極限稼動。

steps.nodeTitleZh: Nintendo Life：棲息地配置與具體家具數值
steps.descEn: Strength: Perfect integration of Pokedex and Habitat Dex requirements. Explains specific item ratios. For instance, 'Bench with Greenery' strictly requires 2 Hedges and 1 Chair.
steps.descZh: 強項功能：將「寶可夢圖鑑」與「棲息地圖鑑 (Habitat Dex)」完美結合，精確標明了每種環境所需的物件比例（例如要搭建「有綠意的長椅」，會明確指引需擺設 2 個樹籬與 1 張椅子），適合家裝玩家。

steps.nodeTitleZh: Eurogamer：300 基礎圖鑑、愛好與活動專刊
steps.descEn: Strength: Hosts all 300 base entries plus Event Pokedex. Breaks details into traditional bio, habitat/weather, and specialties/likes. Understanding likes is key to high comfort.
steps.descZh: 強項功能：提供 300 隻基礎圖鑑與限時「活動圖鑑（Event Pokédex）」記錄。分為傳統生物、棲息天氣、以及最重要的「專長與喜好（Likes）」。掌控喜好是極速提升寶可夢家園舒適度的無上法門。

steps.nodeTitleZh: OP.GG Pokopia：極致篩選與環境偏好
steps.descEn: Strength: Outstanding UI for filtering by attribute, specialty, or environment preference (bright, humid, dark, dry, warm). Marks spawn rarity: C (Common), R (Rare), V (Very Rare).
steps.descZh: 強項功能：無與倫比的高速篩選。可根據寶可夢的屬性、專長、或環境偏好（明亮、潮濕、黑暗、乾燥、溫暖等五大指標）瞬時過濾。且印有極為精準的出沒稀有度指示標籤（Common C / Rare R / Very Rare V）。

steps.nodeTitleZh: Pokopia.center：招募五步迴圈與里程碑獎勵
steps.descEn: Strength: Detailed post-game regional statistics (Kanto ~50, Sinnoh ~14) and 5-step loop analysis. Formally records rewards like titles, garments, and Game Boy components upon reaching 200, 250, and 300 species milestones.
steps.descZh: 強項功能：最深度的宏觀數據分析。列出 1 到 9 世代在關都 (~50 隻) 與神奧 (~14 隻) 等地分佈；精析了招募 5 步迴圈；並精準記錄收集 200、250 與 300 隻時發放的「圖鑑滿載里程碑獎勵」（如專用稱號、高級服飾及 Game Boy 組件）。

steps.nodeTitleZh: Fandom Wiki：玩家社群百科與隱藏技巧
steps.descEn: Strength: Player-supported encyclopedia containing exhaustive items database, interactive grid coordinates, and secret structural blueprints discovered by active sandbox players.
steps.descZh: 強項功能：全集體智慧百科。由全球核心玩家聯動維護。收錄了最冷門的單件家具圖鑑、百變怪地形交互的隱藏格子坐標，以及論壇上玩家測試出的多套一鍵自動回收最佳管線配置。

guides.titleEn: Resource Refining: Core Material Production Chains
guides.titleZh: 資源精煉工業鏈：五大核心建材生產線全解析
guides.subtitleEn: Pokopia is built on a deep refining system. To clear badge quests and the giant end-game structures, you must integrate Pokémon of different specialties into proper production lines. Here is every core material chain, broken down node by node.
guides.subtitleZh: Pokopia 建立了一套極具深度的資源精煉系統。要應付徽章任務與終局大型工程，你必須把不同專長的寶可夢整合進生產線，形成工業鏈。以下逐節點拆解五大核心建材的生產流程。

sections.contentEn: Each chain pairs a raw resource with a specialty Pokémon and a processing station. Set these up early and the mid-to-late game stops being a grind.
sections.contentZh: 每一條生產線都由「原料 ＋ 專長寶可夢 ＋ 加工設備」三者組成。儘早把它們搭建起來，中後期就不再是無止盡的苦工。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 木材生產線（飛天螳螂・居合斬）
steps.descEn: Build a habitat with one large tree and four tall-grass plots to attract Scyther. Learn Cut to split logs into Small Wood Blocks, then commission Scyther to batch-process them into Lumber.
steps.descZh: 建造包含一棵大樹與四格高草叢的棲息地以吸引飛天螳螂。學會「居合斬」即可劈開圓木取得小木塊，再委託飛天螳螂批量切割成木材。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 磚塊生產線（火稚雞 / 小火龍・燃燒）
steps.descEn: Trigger rainfall in the wasteland to gather Soft Clay, then build a 啾啾餐 habitat to attract Torchic or Charmander. Commission these Burn-specialty partners to kiln-bake the clay into Bricks.
steps.descZh: 在荒野引發降雨以獲取「軟泥」，並建造「啾啾餐」棲息地吸引火稚雞或小火龍。委託這些具備「燃燒」專長的夥伴，將軟泥窯烤成磚塊。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 金屬錠生產線（破破袋・回收 ＋ 熔煉爐）
steps.descEn: Mine ore directly, or have Trubbish recycle non-combustible trash into Iron Ore. Build a Smelting Furnace and use a Fire-type's Burn ability to smelt the ore into Iron or Copper Ingots.
steps.descZh: 除了直接開採礦脈，也可邀請具備「回收」專長的破破袋將「不可燃垃圾」轉化為鐵礦。取得鐵礦或銅礦後，建造「熔煉爐」，再借助火系寶可夢的燃燒能力冶煉成鐵錠或銅錠。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 混凝土生產線（隆隆岩 ＋ 修建老匠）
steps.descEn: In the Sparkling Skylands, build a Construction Generator habitat to attract Conkeldurr. Golem's Crush ability breaks rock into Limestone; place the Concrete Mixer in water and let Conkeldurr process the Limestone into Concrete.
steps.descZh: 在閃耀空島建造「工地發電機」棲息地吸引修建老匠。隆隆岩的「粉碎」可將岩石破壞成石灰岩；把「混凝土攪拌機」置入水中，再交由修建老匠將石灰岩加工成混凝土。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 紙張生產線（廢紙・回收）
steps.descEn: Collect Waste Paper scattered across the Sparkling Skylands and hand it to a Recycle-specialty Pokémon (such as Trubbish) to produce usable Paper for badges and 4F construction.
steps.descZh: 在閃耀空島收集散落的「廢紙」，交由具「回收」專長的寶可夢（如破破袋）製作成可用的紙張，供徽章任務與摩天大樓 4F 建設使用。

guides.titleZh: 真新鎮終局沙盒：伊布家族八型態復育全攻略
guides.subtitleEn: Clearing the main story unlocks the pure sandbox region of Palette Town, home to the toughest ecological challenge in the game—restoring Eevee and all eight of its evolutions. Every eeveelution habitat shares the same base recipe: 1 chair, 1 table, and 1 special food locked behind a specific milestone.
guides.subtitleZh: 完成主線後即解鎖純沙盒區域「真新鎮」，這裡藏著全作最嚴苛的生態挑戰——伊布及其八種進化型態的復育。所有伊布棲息地的基礎配方都相同：1 張椅子、1 張桌子，外加 1 種被鎖在特定里程碑之後的特殊食物。

sections.titleZh: 伊布與棲息地基礎配方
sections.contentEn: Eevee itself is encountered the moment you enter the Palette Town Pokémon Center—no special condition required—and carries the Trade specialty. Every evolution then needs the same base habitat (1 chair + 1 table) plus its own unique unlocked food.
sections.contentZh: 進入真新鎮寶可夢中心即可遭遇伊布本體，無任何特殊條件，且牠具備「交易」專長。之後每一種進化型態都需要相同的基礎棲息地（1 張椅子 ＋ 1 張桌子），再加上各自專屬、需解鎖的特殊食物。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 水伊布 — 冰淇淋汽水
steps.descEn: Unlock the Ice Cream Soda recipe by building 10 Water-type habitats throughout Palette Town.
steps.descZh: 在真新鎮建造 10 個水系棲息地，即可解鎖「冰淇淋汽水」食譜。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 雷伊布 — 炸薯條
steps.descEn: Lay a total of 100 electrical facility blocks across the town to unlock the French Fries recipe.
steps.descZh: 在真新鎮鋪設合計 100 塊電力設施方塊，解鎖「炸薯條」食譜。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 火伊布 — 披薩
steps.descEn: Commission Pokémon to assist with construction tasks 15 times to unlock the Pizza recipe.
steps.descZh: 委託寶可夢協助建築施工合計 15 次，解鎖「披薩」食譜。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 太陽伊布 — 下午茶組（白天）
steps.descEn: Have a Pokémon roommate living in your residence. Espeon only spawns during daytime hours; the food unlocked is the Afternoon Tea Set.
steps.descZh: 需在居所中擁有一隻寶可夢室友同住。太陽伊布僅在白天時段生成；解鎖食物為「下午茶組」。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 月亮伊布 — 巧克力餅乾（夜間）
steps.descEn: The most demanding eeveelution: lay 300 physical road blocks to unlock the Chocolate Cookies recipe. Umbreon only spawns at night.
steps.descZh: 最硬核的型態：需鋪設高達 300 塊實體道路方塊，解鎖「巧克力餅乾」食譜。月亮伊布僅在夜間生成。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 葉伊布 — 三明治
steps.descEn: Harvest 100 crops in total across Palette Town's farm plots to unlock the Sandwich recipe.
steps.descZh: 在真新鎮農田合計收成 100 株農作物，解鎖「三明治」食譜。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 冰伊布 — 刨冰
steps.descEn: Reach the highest elevation point of Palette Town's terrain (the summit of the tallest island peak) to unlock the Shaved Ice recipe.
steps.descZh: 抵達真新鎮地形的最高海拔點（最高島嶼山頂），解鎖「刨冰」食譜。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 仙子伊布 — 緞帶蛋糕
steps.descEn: Encounter 10 different Pokémon species within Palette Town to unlock the Ribbon Cake recipe.
